project.title: Aquascape V2 — generated individual artwork
project.description: Correct the rejected scenery prototype by generating complete designed individual props first. The shape, silhouette, painted light, wear and species leaf forms must come from generated artwork and be retained during later 3D reconstruction. This stage produces four original art assets for direct fish-style comparison, not generic material swatches.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied silver arowana illustration's detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, rich carefully painted midtones, delicate highlights, restrained believable colors, readable asymmetrical silhouettes. Detailed hand-painted game sprite appearance with dimensional painted volume. NO low-poly CGI, NO procedural primitive look, NO 3D render, NO photographic grain, NO uniform noise or smooth airbrush. The fish reference establishes the exact drawing finish, not subject matter.
project.gameplay_loop: Review generated aquarium scenery artwork and later reconstruct its designed shapes in 3D.
project.session_goal: Four complete isolated source illustrations, visually reviewed alongside the original fish before any model construction. Keep full native image resolution and source provenance.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1536x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: driftwood_master
asset.description: Generate ONE COMPLETE aged aquarium driftwood root as a finished detailed naturalistic pixel-art game prop, isolated on pure white with ample white margin. Orthographic broad side with a slight top/right view. A grounded irregular thick root crotch left of center, a short broad knotted root reaching down left, a sinuous main limb reaching up to the right in a shallow S with irregular blunt broken tip, and a shorter upward secondary fork. Two small irregular stabilizing roots near the base. About 55cm across, width about twice height. Unique believable natural wood silhouette: asymmetric twists, swelling branch crotches, scalloped broken ends, a small dark cavity near the root base, exposed fibers, darker weathered recesses. ALL branch junctions must blend in continuous natural wood growth. Desaturated deep umber and gray brown with muted honey-colored worn ridges, not bright orange. Paint grain that follows EACH twist and forks through the crotch, not straight vertical stripes. The supplied fish is the precise pixel-art finish reference only; no fish or scales. Readable painted volume and coherent crisp pixel clusters, no grainy photo or smooth CGI. NO tube/cone construction, NO symmetrical starburst, NO evenly tapered spikes, no geometric flat sawcut, no scene, no floor, no cast shadow, text or collage. This is the full designed object, NOT a bark texture.

plan.prompt:
Subject: One complete aged aquarium driftwood root: irregular thick root crotch left of center, short broad knotted root down-left, sinuous main limb rising right in a shallow S to a blunt broken tip, a shorter upward fork, two small stabilizing roots at the base, a dark cavity near the root base and exposed fiber ends. Width about twice height.
Silhouette: Asymmetric, believable weathered wood outline; swelling crotch junctions blending continuous growth, scalloped broken ends, no evenly tapered spikes.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Detailed naturalistic pixel art: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, painted midtones and delicate highlights, dimensional painted volume. Desaturated deep umber and gray brown with muted honey worn ridges; grain painted along each twist and fork, never straight stripes.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Orthographic broad side view with a slight top and right angle.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio background, ample white margin, centered single object, no border, vignette, gradient or ground shadow.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No fish or scales, no bark-texture swatch, no scene, floor or cast shadow, no tube/cone construction, no symmetrical starburst, no flat sawcut, no 3D render, photo grain, smooth airbrush, text or collage.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
